description_en: Starts a disaster recovery drill to ensure the continued replication and clone the data from the last recovery point of the secondary disk to a new disk. This helps you test the completeness and correctness of applications that are deployed on the disaster recovery site on a regular basis
description_zh: 您可以通过演练切换功能确保复制流程持续运行，同时将从盘最近恢复点的数据克隆至一块新的云盘，定期验证容灾站点应用的完整性和正确性
kebab_example: aliyun ebs start-pair-drill --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --pair-id pair-xxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartPairDrill

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the secondary disk in the replication pair. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354206.html operation to query the region in which the secondary disk of the replication pair resides.

You must enable the disaster recovery drill feature in the region in which the secondary site resides
parameters.help_zh:
异步复制对中从盘所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354206.html查询异步复制对的当前从盘所属地域。

必须在当前从端所属地域下启用容灾演练功能
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the replication pair. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354206.html operation to query a list of replication pairs, including replication pair IDs
parameters.help_zh: 复制对ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354206.html查询异步复制对列表，获得复制对ID
parameters.name: pair_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token
